section_path: MMI Daily Iron Ore Index Report October 2 2026
section_path_text: MMI Daily Iron Ore Index Report October 2 2026
summary:
Main
On the second session of the holiday China stayed dark across the board and the seaborne market againpriced alone: the MMi 61% seaborne index fell to USD 92.35/dmt (-0.70%) and the 65% to 111.15 (-0.54%). Across the two closed sessions the 61% is down USD 1.85 (-1.96%) and the 65% USD 0.85 (-0.76%), widening the index-basis high-low spread from USD 17.80 to 18.80 - the same direction as the port spot spread reaching 200 yuan/wmt before the break. At the brand level, though, the structure inverted overnight: yesterday low grades led the fall, today they stood alone on the upside.
